scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute independent three-component vector cross products.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Six products and three differences per 3D vector pair.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Independent pairs of 3D vectors, no mesh or governing PDE.
invariants: Cross product is orthogonal to both inputs in exact arithmetic.
accuracy_requirements: All three Float32 components of 1048576 vectors, absolute tolerance 1e-6, full CPU and dual-reference artifacts.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Product/difference cancellation and possible FMA lowering; fixture uses bounded dyadic values.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: cross3 Float32, contiguous stride1, 1048576 vectors and ten repeats; other native cross variants and Float64 unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Native source references torch.linalg.cross; geometric algebra primitive applicable to many simulations, without one source-evidenced domain application.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Do not turn a generic cross-product operation into evidence of a particular force, mechanics, or graphics model.
scientific_intent.review_phase: retrospective source annotation, no new GPU runs
